frequency_question: How often do major energy permitting/pipeline bills pass and get signed in end-of-session windows?
membership_rule: Members are defined as major energy permitting reform or infrastructure streamlining bills explicitly debated and voted on or attached to must-pass omnibus vehicles during end-of-session windows (November-December) of Congress since 2015.

cases.name: 2022 Manchin Permitting Reform Proposal (End of Year)

coverage_note: 4 named; believed to represent the total population of comparable end-of-session major energy permitting legislative pushes in the last decade.
known_gaps: Excludes minor standalone pipeline riders that passed through committee but never reached floor votes as standalone measures.
skeleton: 4 named end-of-session major permitting legislative pushes
validity_reason: The baseline dynamics of end-of-session omnibus attachments and polarization remain stable over multi-year congressional cycles.
